airport_name, airport_municipality, airport_elevation_ft, and airport_longest_runway_ft each have distinct_count=2 or 3, matching the 3 airport_code values exactly, indicating these are static airport reference attributes repeated across each observation row rather than observation-level measurements.

purpose: This table holds hourly weather observations for three New York-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) covering January through June 2013, with static airport reference attributes (name, municipality, elevation, longest runway) denormalized onto each observation row.
usage: Read the table at one row per airport per UTC observation hour, keyed by airport_code and observed_hour_utc; use observed_date_local and observed_hour_local for local-time reporting. Weather measurement columns (temp_f, dewpoint_f, humidity_pct, wind_dir_degrees, wind_speed_mph, wind_gust_mph, precip_inches, pressure_mb, visibility_miles) describe conditions at that hour; wind_gust_mph and pressure_mb are frequently null and should be filtered or coalesced accordingly before aggregation.
limitations: The profile cannot confirm which column set truly identifies a row in the warehouse; airport_code plus observed_hour_utc is proposed from cardinality (3 x 4341 approx 13023 against row_count 13014) and a duplicate_row_rate of 0.0, but remains unverified until measured. wind_gust_mph (74.6% null) and pressure_mb (11.5% null) are sparse and were kept nullable. captured_at is flagged is_airbyte_metadata=false in the profile, but its clustered 2026 timestamps far outside the 2013 observation window suggest it is pipeline ingestion metadata rather than source data; it is retained and described per the adoption rule, and the reviewer should confirm its purpose. airport_name, airport_municipality, airport_elevation_ft, and airport_longest_runway_ft appear to be static airport dimension attributes denormalized into this observation-grain table, which the reviewer may want to re-examine for normalization, though they are described here as they exist.
